hero.eyebrow: Applied AI & AI product internships · Jan 2027
hero.bio: I build AI tools for real workflows and test ideas against real data, then report what actually holds up.

about.intro: I'm a working student in the CEO office at Gonder Group and a Master in Management student at NOVA SBE in Lisbon. Besides that, I
items: **Build products:** an [operations platform](#work-gonder-platform) at Gonder, [ImmoApp](#work-immoapp) together with Jan, the AI assistant [Co-Driver](#work-co-driver), and [Apto](#work-apto) at a hackathon.
**Test ideas against held-out data** and publish what fails too: none of the [15,000 candidate trading strategies](#work-alpha-graveyard) my search produced survived.
**Freelance** on AI agents and web apps for Connecto / HyCharge, Rancyne and a Microsoft 365 client.
**Look for an applied AI or AI product development internship** from January 2027. [Download my CV](/emilio-gappa-cv.pdf) or [say hi](#say-hi).

projects.name: Operations platform at Gonder
projects.what: An operations platform and a facility-management portal, built in-house at Gonder Group.
projects.result: Takes quoting, costing and fleet exceptions into reviewable workflows, alongside a portal for contracts and service requests. Two apps in production on Azure.
projects.note: Employer work, private code. The case study includes a mock walkthrough.

projects.name: ImmoApp
projects.what: Property-management software for German private landlords, built together with Jan.
projects.figureCaption: in production · iOS beta on TestFlight
projects.result: Helps private landlords prepare tax forms and utility-cost statements, track indexed rents, and reconcile bank transactions.

projects.name: Co-Driver
projects.what: A private AI assistant and personal CRM that triages messages, briefs before meetings and drafts replies.
projects.result: Turns message context into meeting briefs and reviewable drafts. Each action needs approval and a signature on the phone before execution.
projects.note: Private code. The case study includes a simulated approval walkthrough.

projects.name: Apto
projects.what: A START Unicorn Lisbon hackathon app where students solve proctored company work samples and companies rank them.
projects.result: Built almost all of the app at the hackathon; the teammates led the pitch.

visual.alt: Apto landing page with a mock student dashboard

projects.name: alpha-graveyard
projects.what: Automated trading-strategy search, then a test of how many discoveries survive held-out data.
projects.result: The best in-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.65 fell to -0.12 on held-out data, and no candidate passed the Deflated Sharpe test.

projects.name: footnote
projects.what: Cited question answering over SEC 10-K filings, with a harness that measures how often it is right.
projects.result: Hybrid pipeline: 38/64 retrieved, 63/64 with supplied evidence. Reused development questions; neither held-out results nor pure-model accuracy.

projects.name: blind-committee
projects.what: LLM analyst agents, a portfolio manager and a code-based risk manager acting on anonymised evidence.
projects.result: Agents returned +41.3% against +76.3% for equal weight, with a smaller drawdown (-9.2% vs -17.7%) and a Sharpe ratio not clearly different (1.54 vs 1.61).

projects.name: honest-odds
projects.what: A calibration study of 2,946 resolved Polymarket markets, with a strict out-of-sample check.
projects.figureCaption: calibration slope at 30 days (1.0 is calibrated)
projects.result: Prices are close to calibrated. A recalibration strategy had a positive point estimate, but every confidence interval after costs includes zero.
